method: 64 px/m standing turn scale; alpha >= 128, connected crown to sole, median sRGB of rust pixels on upper helmet plate. E = equipped cell 2. For mirror-derived poses source_flag grades the matching original facing; E-rest flags are informational. H: abs(height difference) > 5%; T: CIE76 D65 delta E > 8. R: helmet fraction differs >5% from E. Helmet spans crown to upper central orange collar stripes, or the reviewed lower helmet edge where equipment obscures the band or helmet trim shares its colour. Width/height and mean D65 L* and C* use connected opacity between crown and sole, excluding annotated gun panels when available. Lit cells use matching flashless geometry; projecting weapons use reviewed boot seeds.
